chunks: "The right of the traveller is that his brothers should stay with him for three days when he falls ill."

key_terms.إِخْوَانُهُ: his brothers, meaning his companions or fellow believers
key_terms.اَلْمُسَافِرِ: the traveller, the person away on a journey
key_terms.حَقُّ: a due right or entitlement that must be observed

ai.seo_question: What is the right of a sick traveller over his companions in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches one of the mutual rights owed among companions in travel: if a traveller becomes ill, his companions should remain with him for three days. It emphasizes loyalty, care, and social responsibility toward fellow believers during hardship.
